purpose: Cross-session prior-art and experiment navigation for SchemaRouter typed capability retrieval, historical open-set routing evidence, and end-to-end agent-utility research.
session_bootstrap: Read active B2 issue #423 and its exact frozen preregistration before changing B2 execution code.
Treat B1 workflow 36529108855 as terminal canonical controlled evidence.
Do not use partial/noncanonical B2 attempt outcomes for tuning or protocol repair.
Resume the first active 0.14 workstream/experiment; do not recreate terminal 0.13 methods.
invariants: Only registered schema-backed tools/endpoints may ever become executable candidates.
SchemaRouter 0.14 is evaluated primarily as a typed Top-K capability retrieval substrate; downstream agents select among retrieved candidates.
Retrieval rank/score does not itself grant destructive or irreversible execution authority.
Execution safety remains a separate validation/policy layer for schema, arguments, permissions, provenance, and destructive actions.
Datatype, semantic_id, optional unit, canonical unit normalization, dimension, qualifiers, read/write/destructive metadata remain first-class capability facts.
Top-1 exact route is diagnostic rather than the sole primary product objective; Recall@K and downstream task utility are primary.
Consumed DEV/fresh/confirmation rows from terminal 0.11-0.13 methods may not be used to repair those methods.
B1/B2 conditions must keep tasks, catalogs, agent configuration, executor semantics, and candidate ordering frozen across FULL and SchemaRouter conditions.

workstreams.title: Tool retrieval and executable-schema retrieval alignment

canonical_references.title: Retrieval Models Aren't Tool-Savvy: Benchmarking Tool Retrieval for Large Language Models
ToolReAGt: Tool Retrieval for LLM-based Complex Task Solution via Retrieval Augmented Generation
How Many Tools Should an LLM Agent See? A Chance-Corrected Answer
Dynamic Tool Dependency Retrieval for Lightweight Function Calling
Multi-Field Tool Retrieval
canonical_references.relevance: Directly motivates representing tools as multiple semantically distinct fields rather than one raw documentation blob; relevant to SchemaRouter typed multi-field retrieval and the terminal #434 ablation.

canonical_references.title: Toollery: Scaling LLM Agents to Thousands of Skills and Tools
canonical_references.relevance: Training-free candidate compression over large capability libraries; directly comparable to SchemaRouter's Top-K capability retrieval, context-token reduction, Recall@K, latency, and downstream selection evaluation.

canonical_references.title: ToolSense: A Diagnostic Framework for Auditing Parametric Tool Knowledge in LLMs
canonical_references.relevance: Shows that verbose fully specified tool-retrieval benchmarks can overstate robustness; motivates SchemaRouter's ambiguity, multilingual, distractor, and independently held-out task strata.

canonical_references.title: ToolSearcher: Optimizing Tool Selection at Scale via Reinforcement Learning
canonical_references.relevance: Large-scale multi-turn search and fine-grained tool discrimination; relevant as a learned search baseline/contrast to SchemaRouter's training-free typed retrieval and later corrective re-retrieval work.

canonical_references.title: RAG-MCP: Mitigating Prompt Bloat in LLM Tool Selection via Retrieval-Augmented Generation
canonical_references.relevance: Retrieves a smaller MCP/tool description subset before LLM selection to reduce prompt bloat; directly supports measuring prompt-token reduction together with tool-selection utility.

canonical_references.title: Risk-Aware Reranking for Agentic Tool Retrieval
canonical_references.relevance: Separates relevance from executable-tool exposure risk; relevant to SchemaRouter's typed read/write/destructive metadata and the rule that retrieval never grants execution authority.

canonical_references.title: Beyond Single-Shot: Multi-step Tool Retrieval via Query Planning
canonical_references.relevance: Iterative query planning for compositional tool retrieval; independently supports SchemaRouter's staged execution-state-aware corrective re-retrieval while remaining distinct from the frozen static B2 baseline.
